elements.text: a delivery format applied without rinsing
an agent that attenuates ultraviolet radiation at the scalp
a carrier that spreads through dense hair to reach the skin
a dispenser that meters a fixed dose per application

patents.title: Non-rinse photoprotective mousse for the hair-bearing scalp
patents.abstract: An aerated cosmetic product that remains on the head after use. The mousse carries a UV-absorbing compound and its low surface tension lets it migrate along hair shafts down to the underlying skin.

patents.title: Rinse-off shampoo with ultraviolet filter
patents.abstract: A cleansing shampoo containing an ultraviolet filter, applied to wet hair and rinsed away after lathering.

elements.text: a sensor network that predicts thermal load per cell group
valves that route coolant selectively to hot cell groups
a phase-change material buffer absorbing short heat spikes

patents.title: Adaptive thermal management for battery packs
patents.abstract: Systems for regulating pack temperature by directing liquid coolant through individual module branches according to forecast heat generation derived from per-module thermistors.

patents.title: Phase change ink composition for printing
patents.abstract: A phase change ink that is solid at room temperature and melts in the print head, comprising a wax matrix and colorant.

elements.text: a model trained only on normal traffic, flagging deviations
an air-gapped update channel for detection rules
automatic isolation of a device that raises an alert

patents.title: Machine learning based anomaly detection in industrial control networks
patents.abstract: A monitoring system trains a model on nominal traffic patterns of an industrial control network and raises alerts when observed traffic deviates beyond a learned tolerance. Upon an alert the switch port of the offending controller is disabled.

patents.title: Traffic signal control model for road networks
patents.abstract: A model of vehicle traffic patterns used to time traffic signals, trained on nominal flows observed at intersections.

elements.text: a starch-based matrix providing structural strength
degradation under industrial composting within weeks
an oxygen barrier layer compatible with composting

patents.title: Biodegradable polymer composition for single-use packaging
patents.abstract: A polymer composition comprising a starch-derived matrix and a plasticizer blend that provides mechanical strength comparable to polyethylene while degrading under industrial composting conditions.

patents.title: Oxygen barrier coating for PET bottles
patents.abstract: A silicon oxide barrier coating deposited on polyethylene terephthalate bottles to slow oxygen ingress into carbonated beverages.
